notes.title: Patch Notes for 07/30/23
notes.content:
[b]What has changed?[/b]
Fixed lights at Country House

[b]What's next?[/b]
The game will go out of Early Access at the end of July
Paranormal Mission might get more updates afterwards, but the focus is on Paranormal Observation

[b]Have fun![/b]
